name: Sands Electric Co
old_description: Founded in 1896. Sands Electric has been supplying the Upper Ohio Valley for over 115 years.
about:
Sands Electric Co. has operated from Wheeling, West Virginia since its founding in 1896. The company remains family owned and operated, supplying the Upper Ohio Valley for more than 115 years. No individual founders are named in available records.

The business functions as an electrical wholesale distributor, stocking thousands of products from major industry brands. Its inventory covers a broad range of electrical supplies for commercial, industrial, and residential applications, though specific facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not disclosed.

Sands Electric primarily serves customers throughout the Upper Ohio Valley region. While the company does not list specific industry verticals, its product offering targets electrical contractors, maintenance departments, and other buyers of electrical wholesale goods.

The company emphasizes its long-standing local presence and family ownership as key differentiators, highlighting over a century of continuous service to the region.
